prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion", "Drag your pet anywhere, right-click to hide or summon, and click to start talking anytime!", "Got It, Let's Play!"]
1: ["Design Your Desktop Best Friend", "Select a species and customize colors to see your pet live before adopting.", "Choose Species & Palette"]
2: ["We are preparing your desktop workspace...", "Testing Desktop Compatibility", "We are verifying your display settings so your pet can roam freely on your screen.", "Test Screen Placement"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your pet's traits and access your pet across all devices."]
4: ["Choose How to Create Your Pet", "Don't worry—whichever path you take, your pet is linked safely to your account.", "Existing users: sign in with your original account to restore saved pets.", "Cloud Save Protected"]
5: ["Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward for best pet rendering results.", "Tip: Avoid blurry or heavily shadowed photos for accurate pet generation."]
6: ["Your Pet is Hatching!", "Tap the egg to send cozy vibes while we craft your unique desktop friend.", "Estimated ready time: ~2 minutes"]
7: ["Sign In to Your Companion Account", "Using the same email you registered with restores all existing desktop pets.", "Missing a pet? Ensure you sign in with your primary email provider."]
8: ["Welcome Home! Here is Your Starter Gift", "Your pet is officially on your desktop! You've unlocked an exclusive Starter Crown accessory.", "Reward Unlocked: Starter Crown", "Claim Gift & Start Playing"]
9: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Companion?", "Pick a quick ready-made companion or build a completely custom pet.", "Quick Adoption (1 min) vs Custom Creator (3 mins)"]
